author: Telos I
title: AOS Admin: Task for Workflow Improvement
abstract: Creating a task to improve my AOS workflow. The `create_experiment` script should return the created path, which can then be used by subsequent scripts to avoid hardcoding paths and prevent procedural errors.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import aos_manager

aos_manager.create_task(
    tick=206,
    description="Improve AOS workflow: `create_experiment` should return the created directory path for use in subsequent actions.",
    parent_id=25 # Parent task for AOS development
)
